item.title: Carvel Ice Cream Cakes unveils brand refresh
item.description: The fresh look brings Carvel's recent rebrand to life, pairing the brand's classic heritage with a brighter, bolder, more modern personality. Pops of summery yellow join Carvel's signature cherry red and blue frost, plus playful design elements and iconography nod to Carvel's rich history and nearly a century of ice cream cake innovation.

item.title: Rahm Emanuel hints at 2028 election bid during IDFA Dairy Forum
item.description: IDFA President and CEO Michael Dykes points out 2025 was great for the dairy industry with many potential areas for future growth.

item.title: Dairy Foods presents Processor of the Year award at IDFA Dairy Forum
item.description: Dairy Foods Editor Brian Berk presented the award during a lunch session.

item.title: How Does AI Improve Food Safety? By Catching Defects Before They Reach Customers
item.description: Foreign material recalls in dairy products can significantly undermine consumer trust and result in financial losses. A recent survey indicates that confidence in U.S. food safety has declined, particularly among Gen Z and certain demographic groups. However, advances in detection technologies are helping companies identify and address contamination issues before they reach consumers.

item.title: New York eighth graders create their own ice cream businesses
item.description: Teams presented their business plans to students in grades 5 to 7 and a panel of judges on Jan. 29 at the school.

item.title: From chaos to cruise control: Generative AI and the next era of human-centric warehouse management
item.description: Managing a warehouse today can feel a lot like going on a beach vacation without a plan. You’ve packed your suitcase, brought sunscreen, and maybe even remembered the snacks, but the tides and the long lines at the rental shop all catch you off guard. Traditional warehouse management systems (WMS) can feel the same way.

item.title: Lifeway Foods launches Power Play shake at Barry's Fuel Bar locations
item.description: The Lifeway Power Play shake blends Organic Plain Whole Milk Kefir, blue spirulina, chia seeds, almond milk, vanilla whey protein, granola, and blueberries, providing a protein- and probiotic-packed boost to energize workouts and support recovery.

item.title: Hain Celestial sells snacks business to focus on yogurt and other brands
item.description: Company owns Greek Gods yogurt brand.

item.title: Sargento introduces two new portfolio lines
item.description: Sargento announced it has expanded its natural cheese lineup with two new product lines: Sargento Hot & Spicy Sliced Cheeses and Sargento Balanced Breaks Cheese + Crunch Mixes.

item.title: Kraft debuts Protein Cheese Sticks
item.description: Available in two classic varieties — Mild Cheddar and Pepper Jack— each stick delivers 17 grams of protein per serving and contains 50% less fat than Kraft Natural Cheese’s traditional Mild Cheddar and Pepper Jack Cheese varieties.
